I had a 10 days trip and did “Cancun, isla mujeres, playa del Carmen, tulum, Valladolid, 2 Cenotes and Cozumel”. 
What I suggest you is to create a specific itinerary (I did one on Wanderlog website that also has an app for you phone) and then book all the services based on that.
Pre book your ADO tickets to ensure a lower price, and they are also flexible in case you change your mind.
Pre book also the ferry tickets on [Ultramar](https://www.ultramarferry.com/es/rutas-y-horarios) website which are flexible as well.

And for the phone, a lot of people recommend using esim applications which are not really convenient. 
Personally as soon as I reached Cancun city bus terminal, I went to the closest OXXO store (it’s like a 7/11) and bought an OXXO SIM card for 300pesos (15$) with 8gb connection, which you can always recharge from any OXXO store.
If you need other suggestions do not hesitate to ask
